plans.idea: Editorial top-down stack: brand bar (logo left, NEW VIDEO badge right) on one top line, a big full-width left-aligned headline + subhead block, then the sneaker hero spanning the lower half so the eye reads brand → headline → product.

Product-first thumbnail: centred logo crowns a large sneaker hero in the upper half, then the NEW VIDEO badge sits directly above the headline/subhead block in the lower third like a video title card.

Badge-led headline with brand sign-off: NEW VIDEO badge tags the top-left, headline and subhead hang from it on a shared left edge, the hero sits offset right in the lower half, and the logo signs off in the bottom-left corner to balance it.
